name: Gwinnett Youth Police Academy
what_you_do: A free one-week academy with classroom lessons and hands-on activities. Topics include CPR and AED, emergency driving, and crime scene and crash work. You also learn self defense. You see K9, aviation and SWAT demos.
who_can_apply: Middle and high school students who live in Gwinnett County and will be in 7th through 12th grade as of August. Everyone must pass an application process.
pay_detail: Free. The page says the academy is free.
duration: 1 week, Monday to Friday, 9:00 am to 4:00 pm
deadline_text: Last cycle: application deadline May 29, 2026. The next deadline is not posted.
how_to_apply: Use the Apply Now link on the program page to reach the youth academy application. The page does not describe the steps.
notes: The page names no season or week for the sessions and gives no age range. The only date given is the May 29, 2026 application deadline, so confirm the week before planning. Season is set to summer only because the deadline is in May. Unpaid program, so no work permit. Only the general county number 770.822.8000 is listed.
